claim_reviews.note: Exact PL is the intersection of ambient open normal subgroups with ell-group H-image. The original TWGrp, adapted residual datum, coefficient DVR, IsCO ring, same J and finite point chain are retained.

For open normal H, finite conjugate cores identify the ambient PL with the intrinsic pro-ell residual. Closedness, characteristic normality, finite-quotient criterion and trivial residual iff pro-ell are proved with the needed compactness.

A continuous surjection maps the residual onto the target residual; closedness of the image and the pro-ell quotient give the reverse inclusion. The core argument for an open normal K preserves the ambient Γ, which is essential when K=Γ⁺.

The quotient is profinite. The sign character is killed by P⊂H and the cyclotomic character by all finite principal-unit ell-group quotients, including ell=2. All local maps, c and frame compatibilities remain literal images.

Every original TWQuot field is supplied. Residual-image equality gives the exact kernel lift; original tame errors disappear; convergence pulls back the correct open subgroups; HomL injections preserve finiteness and the same hb; PhiCond remains on unchanged local groups.

The residual characters factor with open kernels and preserve distinctness. Full residual determinant polarization is checked after arbitrary scalar extension using a surjective group-algebra map. Local ψbar and θ are unchanged and Ip=Iu survives.

Primary Chenevier Lemmas 1.19, 1.21 and 2.33 were checked against the full original GDet, generic coefficient CH and discrete reductions. No n! inversion, residual irreducibility, finite coefficient ring or topological finite-generation premise is imported; rank zero is handled separately.

For each coefficient power, continuity supplies one open subgroup killed by the full reduced law. Generic finitely many multiplier variables and coefficientwise I-adic separation prove the entire scalar-extended kernel condition, not merely a trace identity.

In every exact closure quotient, residual characteristic polynomial (X−1)^n and a nilpotent central coefficient ideal make x−1 nilpotent. The commuting ideal (ell,x−1) gives ell-power order by binomial filtration. The finite image of H is an ell-group; the Γ⁺/Γ distinction is resolved by PQL3.

The quotient group-algebra kernel is generated by [k]−1. Full-law factorization is unique after every scalar extension. Continuity, residual law, polarization, ordered ordinary elements and the Ip inertia clause descend with the same ring and local parameters.

The original map B→K given by constant coefficients has maximal kernel since its image is a finite field, hence kills m_B. The finite Z_ell-algebra K has characteristic ell. Cayley–Hamilton and characteristic-ell powers establish the full-matrix NP.UnipOn, with no coefficient extension.

Modulo I^m, the simultaneous representation/cocycle kernel is an open normal semidirect-product kernel. One extra ell-power kills the cocycle after killing the representation. Compactness makes the group quotient finite even if R/I^m is infinite. Separation gives exact descent and quotient-topology continuity.

Every NP field is preserved, including integral block data, span over G′, N1, ψ_mu, local types and triangularity. Every Kap field is preserved with the same g, κ pullbacks and Y. Selmer/boundary equivalence uses the exact prescribed subspaces, transpose symmetry, local witnesses and quotient topology; generation descends by surjectivity.

The original truncated coefficients and paired first-order ring are retained. The e_j-ideal has square zero, so the first-order representation has ell-power order on the same H_N. PQL12 gives descent of SelP, Sel1 and Sel2 with their original local and polarization clauses.

Pullback injects Sel1 and bijects boundary sets using exactly the same Y; the cardinal bound and finiteness preserve C before m and the same eventual levels. For B2 the full array pulls up and Ψ descends, preserving the unit coefficient, C and every e′-coordinate relation.

The descended point uses literally the same K, O-algebra structure, f:B→K[[t]] and eigenvalue array. Full-law equality is checked by surjective pullback; all point prime kernels and field cardinalities in an arbitrary finite chain are unchanged.

The full supplied TWAut transports with the same rings, modules, λ, weight variables, J and support equivalence. The splitting algebra is identified through exact characteristic-polynomial equality. Both composition equations and ordered rel1/rel2 retain the original f_N scalar and common exponent.

For an arbitrary upstairs open normal V, using V′=g(V) proves the required inverse-image containment of the exact closed augmentation ideal. All generic CH, ordinary, inertia and polarized generators lift; the kernel is already in every upstairs closure term. No invalid exchange of image and infinite intersection is used.

The induced algebra direction is E′→E. A quotient of a semisimple ring is semisimple, giving precisely upstairs NonSS⇒downstairs NonSS at the same field map f and prime, with no converse claimed. Discriminant equivalence follows from push/lift of the same n²-tuples.

The exact CoreBC consumer is applied to the actual quotient system, unchanged ring/J and all original points. GenBy, adaptation, equal field cardinalities, intermediate NonSS primes and start/end predicates transfer in the required directions. The conclusion is full ChainConcl for arbitrary h and hence Raw; ell≠2 is retained.

The selected h=0,a=n=4,g=0,ell=3 use is only an internal closure. The same quotient is supplied to the companion S4 route; coefficient normalization/CoreBC production, limiting patching/S5 and original ordinary/Hida/HasAut contracts remain. No whole Count-II leaf or final theorem is claimed closed.
